detailed_descriptions_html.en:
⛽ Serve Customers & Fuel Cars 

Fill up cars with the right fuel, stop at the right amount, and get paid for a job well done. Be precise, move fast, and keep customers happy… or mess things up and watch their reactions. 

 

🧽 Clean, Repair & Upgrade Cars 

Some cars arrive dirty, broken, or missing parts. Clean them, repair them, replace car parts, and earn extra cash for good service. The better you work, the better your rewards. 

 

🔨 Steal Parts, Break Cars & Create Chaos 

Don’t feel like being a perfect employee? Steal mirrors, break windows, damage cars, spray fuel everywhere. Every tool can become a source of chaos. 

 

🚚 Buy New Tools From the Delivery Truck 

A delivery truck regularly stops by with new tools, weapons, items, and consumables. Spend your cash to unlock more ways to serve customers, prank them, or completely ruin their day. 

 

🎨 Paint, Burn, Spray & Experiment 

Use spray paint, fuel, lighters, weird items, and other tools to experiment with customers and cars.  

 

🚓 Catch Wanted Fugitives 

The sheriff may ask for your help. Watch the queue, identify wanted drivers, and stop them to earn special rewards. Serve them normally… or take them down your own way. 

 

⭐ Earn Cash, Reviews & Climb the Leaderboard 

Complete missions, collect money, unlock new tools, and build your reputation. Customers leave reviews based on what happened to them.
